sample_unit: doctors (general practitioners) completing 9 clinical vignettes each
models_evaluated: Conceptual prototype of AI-based CDS representing traditional machine learning ASCVD risk calculators
unlisted_practices: AI-based clinical decision support for 10-year ASCVD risk assessment and statin prescribing in primary care compared with automated CDS and no decision support

screen.reason: The study tests the diagnostic and management impact of providing an AI-based clinical decision support tool versus automated CDS or no assistance on simulated clinical vignettes, rather than testing a specific deployment practice or operational safeguard.
